Messages.Author: davey sprocket
Messages.Body:
Suppose Sir Walter Nash plays a political action, such as Kine Resources
Contested. He also plays superior Bewitching Oration to gain 4 votes. The
Methuselah controlling Walter has 7 votes:

1 from the vote card
2 from Walter's title of prince
4 from Bewitching Oration.

The question is: how many of these votes can be cancelled by Pulling
Strings or Demonstration?
